messages:
rowan: Quick check from Cerulean onboarding health scan  p95 crept from ~130ms to ~290ms during US peak, renewal sentiment is lukewarm if we don't give a concrete plan :worried:
izzy: Do we have traces? Is it compute-bound, queueing, or network?
cole: Mostly queueing + KV cache churn on long sessions. They're on a 28B fp16 model, no quant in prod. Cross-region tails too since traffic fans out to us-central.
mira: I'm proposing a 'smoothpath' pilot: per-priority dynamic quant + a midsize fallback for burst traffic. Key pieces: per-segment mixed-precision (hot layers int8, stable layers fp16), geo-aware routing to keep APAC/EU in-region, and a compact 10B fallback for non-critical intents.
rowan: Sounds promising. Canary idea: 4% of priority traffic -> cerulean-28b-segment-int8 on a dedicated pool in-region; 6% -> cerulean-10b-compact hosted fallback for bursts. 48h window, ramp after quality checks.
izzy: For routing policy: route_by_priority_tag -> prefer-dedicated-{region} pool -> if queue_depth>7 OR p95>400ms -> increase fallback fraction. Also enable sticky-session affinity to preserve KV caches.
cole: ML notes: segment-wise quant needs a small attention-kernel tweak for seq_len up to 1800; will run layer-sensitivity sweep to identify safe layers. We'll run regen-quality eval on Cerulean's intent set and compute token-cost delta.
mira: CS wants simple numbers for the renewal deck: token-cost delta, regen-f1/bleu delta, and p95 before/after. Also a short A/B script and automated scoring so customer can flag perceived quality issues.
rowan: Can you drop a compact config snippet for the canary?
mira: Posted snippet: ```json
{"pilot":{"duration_hours":48,"canary":{"priority_percent":4,"fallback_percent":6}},"models":[{"name":"cerulean-28b-seg-int8","route":"dedicated-region"},{"name":"cerulean-10b-compact","route":"hosted-fallback"}],"slo":{"per_request_timeout_ms":2300,"circuit_breaker_retries":1}}
```
izzy: Ops checklist: pre-warm KV caches, enable KV-prefetch, set autoscale min_instances=2 for canary pool, expose per-route metrics (p50/p95/p99, queue_depth, token_cost, regen_score), and add alert thresholds.
cole: Ballpark cost delta: segment-int8 ~30-38% token-cost reduction vs fp16; 10B compact ~60-70% on fallback slices. Latency: int8 compute might add ~10-20ms on short seqs but reduces tail by preventing queues.
rowan: Acceptance & rollback: regen-f1 drop <=1.5pts, hallucination delta <=0.5%, user-flag rate <1% sustained. Rollback if any trigger exceeded for 30m. Also log prompt_id+eval_id to auto-flag in console.
mira: We'll attach a tiny user feedback form to the canary so Cerulean can quickly mark any perceived quality regressions. Also run a synthetic surge test pre-canary to validate autoscaling.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket CS-12547 for Cerulean smoothpath pilot and attach ML-EVAL-12547.
rowan: Great work. Tagging @izzy @cole @mira  Izzy, can you post the eval suite and the A/B script by EOD? We'll propose canary window Thu 07:00-11:00 PT to capture peak.
izzy: On it  will include regen samples, scoring notebook, and automated alerts.
rowan: This gives Cerulean a concrete path to lower unit cost and stabilize p95 ahead of renewal. :thumbsup:
